title: Rockefeller serves breakfast and vows to get disclosure

tellings.quote: Rockefeller goes he he's talking Bud Hopkins told me a story he's there Jacobs and him are at uh him and Mack are at uh Rockefeller's house And Rockefeller is like a butler and he's taking bringing him breakfast and stuff like that. And they thought this is kind of weird this billionaires, you know, feeding us breakfast and stuff. And he he said, "I'm going to I'm going to get disclosure."

plain: In the 1990s, the billionaire Laurance Rockefeller is said to have played butler to three guests at his house, carrying in their breakfast himself, and to have told them, "I'm going to get disclosure," meaning he would get the US government to reveal publicly what it knows about UFOs. The guests were Budd Hopkins, David Jacobs and John Mack, researchers who studied people's accounts of being taken by aliens, and they found it strange to be fed by a billionaire. A researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels this second-hand, as a story Hopkins told him, and he links it to files on Rockefeller's effort released under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records.
